title: Demo · Attempt to murder under the BNS, co-accused on bail
story: Accused-1 is charged under BNS 109 and 3(5) for a knife wound in a quarrel over parking on 13.03.2025, an attempt to murder. He has been in custody since 16.03.2025; the charge sheet was filed on day 81 of 90, in time. The Rights Radar takes the maximum punishment as death: default bail is WINDOW_CLOSED (the charge sheet came inside the 90 days) and the BNSS s.479 undertrial limit is NOT_APPLICABLE, because s.479(1) does not apply where the maximum is death or life imprisonment. His bail was refused by the Sessions Court, and Co-accused-2, said to have only held the injured, was granted bail by the High Court.

variant.offence: BNS 109 with 3(5), attempt to murder (the radar takes the section's highest maximum, death), offence after 1 July 2024
variant.custody: charge sheet filed on day 81 of 90, in time, so default bail is WINDOW_CLOSED; BNSS s.479 is NOT_APPLICABLE because the radar takes the maximum as death
variant.record: complete file, eleven born-digital documents including the medico-legal report
variant.parity: Co-accused-2 granted bail with a lesser role; first-time offender; earlier bail application rejected

steps.title: Rights Radar
steps.caption: At intake Peshkar ran the 7 rules of the Rights Radar on the dossier as of 2026-11-15: date arithmetic and statute tables, not the language model. Default bail: WINDOW_CLOSED, Production within 24 hours: CHECK and Antil category: B. Each result names its rule and the dates it used; rules not yet re-checked against the bare act are marked unverified.

filled.label: Default bail
filled.value: WINDOW_CLOSED: 90-day limit (maximum death). Day 1 is the first remand, 17.03.2025. The charge sheet was filed on day 81 (05.06.2025). It came within the limit, so the right to default bail never arose.

filled.label: Undertrial limit (BNSS s.479)
filled.value: NOT_APPLICABLE: Maximum punishment is death; BNSS s.479(1) does not apply to death or life imprisonment.

filled.label: Notice of appearance
filled.value: OK: Maximum punishment is death, above 7 years, so the notice-of-appearance norm is not engaged.

filled.label: Grounds of arrest
filled.value: UNKNOWN: No record that the grounds of arrest were communicated.

filled.label: Production within 24 hours
filled.value: CHECK: Produced the next day; times not on record.

filled.label: Antil category
filled.value: B: Maximum punishment is death: category B (death, life or more than 7 years). Antil's categories decide how an accused who was not arrested during investigation and cooperated is treated after the charge sheet; for a client in custody this is context, not a bail entitlement.

filled.label: Statutory bar
filled.value: NOT_APPLICABLE: No NDPS, UAPA or PMLA section is charged.

Abhiyojak judged 0 of Vakeel's replies: 0 answered, 0 partly answered, 0 unanswered; 13 objections could not be judged because the sparring token budget was spent, and stay unanswered.
